It is still on my timeline so do watch it," she wrote on X on Monday night.

item.title: World to add less clean energy capacity this year, renewables agency chief says
item.description: The world will add less clean energy capacity in 2026 for the first time in five years due to inadequate transmission networks and trade barriers, the chief of the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) said.
item.dc:creator: Sudarshan Varadhan
item.content:encoded: The world will add less clean energy capacity in 2026 for the first time in five years due to inadequate transmission networks and trade barriers, the chief of the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) said. Growth in solar and wind capacity has been accelerating every year since 2021, when the coronavirus pandemic disrupted global supply chains. Clean power installations including hydropower surged a record 692 gigawatts, or 15.5%, to 5,149 GW in 2025 — representing half the world's power capacity. Governments have pledged to boost clean energy use to ensure reliable power supply and cut costs, particularly after the US-Israeli war with Iran choked energy supplies and inflated prices. But IRENA Director-General Francesco La Camera noted that there has been a slowdown in renewables deployment in China due to curtailment — or rejection of clean power when a grid hits its limits. "The main cause of a lack of new record in additions this year is the mismatch between generation capacity and the capacity to distribute and transmit electricity," he told Reuters on the sidelines of the Singapore International Energy Week conference. China, the world's biggest renewable energy producer, turned away enough clean energy to power Mexico for a year in the first half of 2026, while networks in nations such as Australia and Japan also failed to keep pace with a surging renewables buildout. "The amount of the (capacity) increase in the other parts of the world this year, I don't think it will offset the slowing down in China," La Camera said. He declined to provide a numerical forecast for expected growth in clean energy additions this year. Renewable energy additions are crucial to reducing global emissions, and the United Nations said in a report last week that "urgent and stringent" emission cuts were required to slow global warming.

item.title: US stock futures muted as oil holds near April highs ahead of Fed decision
item.description: US stock index futures were little changed on Tuesday as crude oil hovered near its highest in six weeks, while investor attention turned to a slate of key corporate earnings and the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision this week.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US stock index futures were little changed on Tuesday as crude oil hovered near its highest in six weeks, while investor attention turned to a slate of key corporate earnings and the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision this week. The Fed is widely expected to [USN:L6N46518P TEXT:"hold rates"] steady on Wednesday following an increase last month, though markets are pricing in at least two more hikes by mid-2027 as key inflation indicators remain elevated amid the ongoing US-Iran conflict. "While we don't expect a rate move this week, we wouldn't be against a hike even though we're not convinced of its urgency," said John Velis, head of Americas Strategy at BNY. "We think maintaining credibility is paramount for the Fed, and as (Fed Chair Kevin) Warsh likes to remind us, the inflation target has been exceeded for well over 60 straight months." Crude oil prices were slightly higher on Tuesday after falling in the previous session, with Brent crude near its highest level since late April. At 05:17 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis were up 70 points, or 0.14%, S&P 500 E-minis were up 3.75 points, or 0.05%, and Nasdaq 100 E-minis were up 2 points, or 0.01%. Megacap and growth stocks were mixed. Tesla (TSLA.O) shares climbed close to 1% in premarket trading, after jumping more than 5% in the last session. Meta Platforms (META.O) was flat after the company increased its largest-ever [USN:L3N46C0RT TEXT:"equity fundraising"] to $97.5 billion to fund AI expansion. Whirlpool (WHR.N) dropped 8.8% after the home appliance maker [USN:L2N46C0YW TEXT:"reported"] a third-quarter loss and missed revenue estimates. Coca-Cola (KO.N) , Boeing (BA.N) and PayPal (PYPL.O) are some of the major companies scheduled to report earnings before markets open on Tuesday. Hyperscalers Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) and Amazon.com (AMZN.O) are set to report later this week. Their results will be parsed for signs of whether the hefty AI investments are translating into growth. Jefferies equity strategist Jane Gibbons said in a note that growth for 'Magnificent 7' names could trail the rest of the S&P 500. The brokerage sees earnings for the group of the biggest US tech stocks growing at 21% versus 32% for the rest for the benchmark. The AI trade has come under pressure this month on growing concerns that debt-funded spending may become harder to justify in the face of rising borrowing costs. Investor sentiment improved somewhat in the [USN:L4N469179 TEXT:"previous session"], however, after AI lab Anthropic [USN:L3N46C10M TEXT:"revealed its IPO filing"], taking a big step towards a potentially record-breaking listing even as it disclosed steep losses and security concerns. The development had helped lift chip stocks (.SOX) after a bruising few weeks, along with other AI beneficiaries, including photonic product makers and neoclouds. Separately, investors are looking ahead to the November 3 midterm elections, which will decide control of the US Congress.

item.title: Jordan says it killed more than 20 Islamic State militants in airstrikes on Syria
item.description: Jordan killed more than 20 Islamic State militants in airstrikes on southern Syria on Monday evening following a deadly attack on a church in Jordan, Government Communication Minister Mohammed al-Momani said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jordan killed more than 20 Islamic State militants in airstrikes on southern Syria on Monday evening following a deadly attack on a church in Jordan, Government Communication Minister Mohammed al-Momani said on Tuesday. Syria said the Jordanian strikes had killed seven people, including three children and a woman. Jordan regrets civilian casualties, Momani said in a post on X. Jordan said on Monday its air force had struck what it described as [USN:L2N46C03X TEXT:"militant hideouts"] in southern Syria after determining that the suspects behind last week's church attack were linked to "terrorist groups" operating there. Senior government security officials said on Monday that Jordanian security forces had arrested two brothers and their brother-in-law after a shootout over the church violence that killed nine people. There has been no claim of responsibility by Islamic State. The Jordanian armed forces said the operation was conducted in coordination with Damascus. Syria's government said the airstrikes were carried out without coordination with Damascus and that it had launched an investigation into the attacks.

item.title: Private equity smash and grab may sound IPO alarm
item.description: Security group Verisure has fallen 30% since floating one year ago, despite strong sales. CVC is considering taking the firm private again. It would be a decent deal – but end up reinforcing fears that public markets can’t digest the types of assets buyout shops need to list.
item.dc:creator: Jennifer Johnson
item.content:encoded: Security group Verisure has fallen 30% since floating one year ago, despite strong sales. CVC is considering taking the firm private again. It would be a decent deal – but end up reinforcing fears that public markets can’t digest the types of assets buyout shops need to list. Full view will be published shortly. Follow Jennifer Johnson on Bluesky and LinkedIn . CONTEXT NEWS Buyout group CVC Capital Partners is in the very early stages of assessing a bid to take Verisure private, a person familiar with the matter [USN:L4N4671NW TEXT:"told Reuters"] on October 21. This comes less than a year after Hellman & Friedman floated the Swedish security firm in Stockholm. There was no guarantee Amsterdam-listed CVC would pursue a deal, and no offer has been made to Verisure, the source said. Hellman & Friedman remains Verisure's largest shareholder with a stake of nearly 44%, according to LSEG data.

item.title: Qatar extends force majeure on LNG cargoes to Italy's Edison until end-December
item.description: QatarEnergy will prolong its Iran war-related suspension of liquefied natural gas (LNG) deliveries to Edison until the end of December, the Italian utility said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Francesca Landini, Gianluca Semeraro
item.content:encoded: QatarEnergy will prolong its Iran war-related suspension of liquefied natural gas (LNG) deliveries to Edison (EDNn.MI) until the end of December, the Italian utility said on Tuesday. In a message on the platform of Italy's energy markets manager GME, Edison said QatarEnergy had notified the extension of force majeure on LNG deliveries from a previous [USN:L8N45K0HY TEXT:"early-December"] deadline. A further three LNG cargoes that were intended for the Italian utility - one of Qatar's biggest customers in Europe - will be affected by the suspension, Edison said. QatarEnergy first notified the cancellation of LNG deliveries in April, following trade disruptions and damages to its LNG plants in Qatar caused by the US-Israeli war on Iran , started in late February. Edison holds a long-term contract with QatarEnergy for the supply of 6.4 billion cubic metres of natural gas per year to Italy, around 10% of the country's total consumption. The contract, which has been in force since 2009, has a total duration of 25 years.

item.title: Football-Mbappé perd plusieurs partenaires chinois, accusé d'avoir heurté les sentiments nationaux
item.description: Kylian Mbappé a été lâché par plusieurs entreprises chinoises après la polémique suscitée par ses propos présumés dans une vidéo où l'attaquant français semble plaisanter au sujet d'une image le confondant avec l'ancien dirigeant chinois Mao Zedong.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kylian Mbappé a été lâché par plusieurs entreprises chinoises après la polémique suscitée par ses propos présumés dans une vidéo où l'attaquant français semble plaisanter au sujet d'une image le confondant avec l'ancien dirigeant chinois Mao Zedong. Dans une vidéo apparue en ligne lundi, on entend Kylian Mbappé expliquer que le "mème" - une image ou une vidéo, souvent parodique, reprise massivement sur internet - le plus drôle qu'il ait vu de lui-même était celui où son visage avait été greffé sur celui d'"un dictateur chinois". Les fans ont multiplié les mèmes superposant le visage du Madrilène à ceux de dirigeants militaires et politiques, suggérant son supposé autoritarisme. Reuters n'a pas été en mesure d'authentifier la vidéo. Fondateur de la République populaire de Chine, Mao Zedong est perçu par nombre de Chinois comme le sauveur de la nation et les plaisanteries à son sujet sont considérées comme un tabou. Il est mort en 1976. Dans un communiqué publié sur le réseau social chinois Weibo, Eastroc Beverage, qui utilisait l'image de Kylian Mbappé sur ses boissons, a déclaré s'opposer fermement à tout "comportement qui heurte les sentiments nationaux". "À compter de ce jour, nous mettons fin à toute coopération avec Kylian Mbappé", a ajouté la marque. Les représentants du champion du monde 2018 n'ont pas répondu dans l'immédiat aux sollicitations de Reuters. Dans un entretien accordé le mois dernier à L'Équipe, le Tricolore avait estimé que si certains aspects de cette tendance relevaient du simple divertissement, les mèmes viraux le présentant en dictateur traduisaient "un manque de conscience politique et humaine chez les gens". Les groupes laitiers Mengniu et Milkground ont eux aussi mis fin à leur partenariat avec l'attaquant français. Interrogé sur l'affaire, un porte-parole du ministère chinois des Affaires étrangères a indiqué que les paroles et actes portant atteinte aux sentiments du peuple chinois "se heurteront naturellement à un rejet commun de l'ensemble de la société". La télévision d'État chinoise a suspendu la diffusion de tous les matches et événements impliquant la Liga et Kylian Mbappé. Les publicités dans lesquelles apparaît le joueur ont également été retirées, a rapporté mardi The Paper, un média public chinois. La Liga et le Real Madrid n'ont pas répondu dans l'immédiat à une demande de commentaire.

item.title: Netherlands won't join 2027 Eurovision Song Contest as Israel protest continues
item.description: The Netherlands will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest as no broadcaster is willing to take responsibility for the Dutch entry due to concern over Israel's participation, broadcaster association NPO said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Netherlands will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest as no broadcaster is willing to take responsibility for the Dutch entry due to concern over Israel's participation, broadcaster association NPO said on Tuesday. The NPO last month said it was confident the Netherlands [USN:L6N45F0PN TEXT:"would return"] to the contest next year, after a boycott of the 2026 edition, as it felt the European Broadcasting Union had responded to criticism by countries that had not participated in 2026. But ultimately no Dutch broadcaster was willing to facilitate the Dutch bid. Ireland, Iceland, Spain, Slovenia and the Netherlands all boycotted the contest in May in protest at the participation of Israel and its military offensive in Gaza.

item.description: As ações chinesas perderam os ganhos registrados no início do dia e fecharam nesta terça-feira em sua menor cotação em 14 meses, com os papéis do setor de tecnologia retomando a queda após uma breve alta impulsionada por uma melhora no ânimo dos investidores na região.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As ações chinesas perderam os ganhos registrados no início do dia e fecharam nesta terça-feira em sua menor cotação em 14 meses, com os papéis do setor de tecnologia retomando a queda após uma breve alta impulsionada por uma melhora no ânimo dos investidores na região. No fechamento, o índice de Xangai (.SSEC) teve queda de 1,3%, o nível mais baixo desde agosto de 2025. O índice CSI300 (.CSI300) , que reúne as maiores companhias listadas em Xangai e Shenzhen, também recuou 1,3%. O índice Hang Seng (.HSI) , de Hong Kong, caiu 0,7%, e o índice Hang Seng de Tecnologia (.HSTECH) recuou 1,5%. O Índice Composto ChiNext (.CNT) , voltado para startups, caiu 3,4%, e o índice STAR50 de Xangai (.STAR50) , com foco em tecnologia, despencou 4,8%, atingindo o nível mais baixo desde março. Mais cedo, os índices haviam subido até 1,2% e 0,8%, respectivamente. Na região, as ações asiáticas subiram na terça-feira, à medida que o tão aguardado pedido de IPO da empresa de IA Anthropic aumentou o apetite pelo risco, antecipando os resultados financeiros do setor de tecnologia — que serão um teste para o mercado de IA — e as reuniões dos bancos centrais, que influenciarão as taxas de juros no curto prazo. A onda de vendas de ações chinesas relacionadas à IA, no entanto, continuou, com o índice CSI de chips (.CSI931865) caindo 5,8%, atingindo uma nova mínima de seis meses, e o índice CSI de IA (.CSI930713) recuando quase 4%. O índice CSI de Bancos (.CSI399986) , considerado defensivo, registrou alta de 1,3%. . Em TÓQUIO, o índice Nikkei (.N225) avançou 1,73%, a 63.268 pontos. . Em HONG KONG, o índice HANG SENG (.HSI) caiu 0,73%, a 23.041 pontos. . Em XANGAI, o índice SSEC (.SSEC) perdeu 1,33%, a 3.648 pontos. . item.title: Norway's prime minister, Finland's president in phone call with Putin
item.description: Finnish President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Stoere on Tuesday held a phone call with Russian President Vladimir Putin regarding the war in Ukraine, Stubb's office said in a statement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Finnish President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Stoere on Tuesday held a phone call with Russian President Vladimir Putin regarding the war in Ukraine, Stubb's office said in a statement. Western European leaders have mostly shunned contact with Putin since Russia launched its full-scale war in Ukraine in February 2022. "The discussion was frank and substantive. We are neighbouring countries to Russia. The outcome of this war will have a direct impact on our and the broader European security. Ending the war requires direct discussions," Stubb said in a statement. Russia has frequently accused European governments of stoking the war by arming Ukraine and refusing to talk to Moscow. It has contrasted their stance with that of US President Donald Trump, who has engaged with Putin and tried - so far without success - to broker a peace agreement. Stoere and Stubb met US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy in Oslo last week, a day before Witkoff met Putin in St Petersburg. The Kremlin said after the Putin-Witkoff talks that Russia was willing to resume US-mediated peace talks with Ukraine in November, for the first time since February.

item.title: Marcas chinas rompen con Mbappé tras sus supuestos comentarios sobre un meme de Mao
item.description: Varias marcas chinas han roto sus vínculos con Kylian Mbappé tras la polémica por sus presuntos comentarios sobre un meme con una imagen que se asemejaba al fallecido líder chino Mao Zedong.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Varias marcas chinas han roto sus vínculos con Kylian Mbappé tras la polémica por sus presuntos comentarios sobre un meme con una imagen que se asemejaba al fallecido líder chino Mao Zedong. En un video que apareció en internet el lunes, se oye a Mbappé decir que el meme más divertido que había visto sobre sí mismo era uno en el que su rostro se había fusionado con el de "un dictador chino". Los aficionados han estado creando memes que superponen el rostro de Mbappé a imágenes de líderes militares y políticos como alusión al poder que supuestamente tiene de tomar las decisiones en los equipos en los que juega. Reuters no ha podido verificar la autenticidad del video. Mao, fundador de la República Popular China, es venerado por muchos como el salvador de la nación y las bromas sobre él se consideran tabú. Murió en 1976. En un comunicado publicado en la red social china Weibo, Eastroc Beverage, que utilizaba el rostro de Mbappé en sus bebidas, afirmó que se oponía firmemente a "los comportamientos que hieren el sentimiento nacional". "Con efecto inmediato, ponemos fin a toda colaboración con Kylian Mbappé", añadió. Los representantes de Mbappé no respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. En una entrevista con L'Équipe el mes pasado, Mbappé dijo que, si bien algunos aspectos de esa tendencia eran una diversión inofensiva, los memes virales que lo representaban como un dictador mostraban "una falta de conciencia política y humana". Las empresas lácteas Mengniu y Milkground también pusieron fin a su colaboración con Mbappé. A preguntas acerca del incidente, un portavoz del Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de China respondió que las palabras y acciones que hieren los sentimientos del pueblo chino "se encontrarán, naturalmente, con la oposición conjunta de todos los sectores de la sociedad china". La televisión estatal china ha suspendido las transmisiones de todos los partidos y eventos relacionados con LaLiga y Mbappé, y se han retirado todos los anuncios en los que aparece el futbolista, informó el martes el medio estatal The Paper. LaLiga y el Real Madrid no respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.

item.title: Iraqi court sentences six French men to life in prison for Islamic State membership
item.description: An Iraqi court on Tuesday sentenced six French nationals to life in prison and a seventh to 15 years after convicting them of membership in Islamic State, a Reuters witness inside the courtroom said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Iraqi court on Tuesday sentenced six French nationals to life in prison and a seventh to 15 years after convicting them of membership in Islamic State, a Reuters witness inside the courtroom said. The men were among 47 French Islamic State suspects transferred from detention facilities in northeast Syria to Iraq last year under a broader relocation arrangement coordinated by US forces and Iraqi authorities. The presiding judge said the sentences were imposed under Iraq's counterterrorism law for joining Islamic State and spreading fear. He added that the court had opted for life imprisonment rather than the death penalty because the defendants were young. A seventh French national, aged 23, was given a 15-year sentence, according to the Reuters witness. Abbas al-Maliki, one of the lawyers for the defendants, said the group would appeal the sentence in the Court of Cassation. Iraq [USN:L6N45C01V TEXT:"opened"] the trial of the French nationals last month. Islamic State seized large parts of Iraq and Syria in 2014 before being driven from its self-declared caliphate by a US-led coalition and local forces in 2019. Many of the group's militants were detained, although remnants of the jihadist organization continue to operate. The United States announced in January that it had begun [USN:L1N3YN16J TEXT:"transferring"] Islamic State detainees from Syria to Iraq amid concerns about the security of detention facilities in northeast Syria after Kurdish-led forces lost control of parts of the region.

item.title: La demanda de hipotecas cae en la eurozona mientras suben las tasas, según una encuesta del BCE
item.description: La demanda de hipotecas en la zona euro cayó con fuerza en los tres meses hasta septiembre, en un contexto de subidas de las tasas de interés y mayores dificultades para acceder al crédito, según una encuesta del Banco Central Europeo publicada el martes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La demanda de hipotecas en la zona euro cayó con fuerza en los tres meses hasta septiembre, en un contexto de subidas de las tasas de interés y mayores dificultades para acceder al crédito, según una encuesta del Banco Central Europeo publicada el martes. La encuesta trimestral sobre préstamos bancarios del BCE mostró el impacto tangible del endurecimiento de la política monetaria de la entidad, que comenzó en junio y se prevé que continúe durante meses, en respuesta al repunte de la inflación en la zona euro impulsado por la guerra. Un porcentaje neto del 27% de los bancos informó de una disminución de la demanda de préstamos para la compra de vivienda en el tercer trimestre del año, una caída más pronunciada de lo que las entidades habían previsto (-12%) y de la que habían comunicado en los tres meses anteriores (-15%). "Las subidas de las tasas de interés fueron el principal factor de la caída, seguidas del descenso de la confianza de los consumidores y del deterioro de las perspectivas del mercado de la vivienda", señaló el BCE en un comunicado. Los bancos no endurecieron los criterios para conceder hipotecas durante el trimestre, aunque sí lo hicieron para los préstamos a empresas y el crédito al consumo. Prevén endurecer los criterios de concesión de todo tipo de préstamos en los últimos tres meses del año. Francia, que se encuentra en el centro de las turbulencias del mercado de bonos por la situación de sus finanzas públicas, fue el gran país europeo donde ese endurecimiento fue más pronunciado. "La mayor percepción de riesgos y la menor tolerancia al riesgo de los bancos siguieron siendo los principales factores del endurecimiento de los criterios de concesión de crédito, y algunas entidades señalaron una creciente presión derivada de la incertidumbre geopolítica y de la evolución del sector energético", indicó el BCE. Preguntados por la inteligencia artificial, la mayoría de los bancos señaló que aún no había introducido criterios cuantitativos para evaluar los préstamos relacionados con la IA, y sólo un pequeño número afirmó que esta figuraba cada vez más en sus evaluaciones cualitativas.

item.title: Brewers eye sweep for first Series title, while Rays try to stay alive
item.description: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Milwaukee Brewers will bid to make history Tuesday in more ways than one.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Milwaukee Brewers will bid to make history Tuesday in more ways than one. Sure, the Brewers will vie for the franchise's first World Series title when they play Game 4 against the Tampa Bay Rays. Should they complete a sweep, they'll be the first team to accomplish the feat in both the League Championship Series and the World Series since the LCS became a best-of-seven set in 1985. The 1976 Cincinnati Reds swept the Philadelphia Phillies in a best-of-five National League Championship Series before brushing aside the New York Yankees in the World Series. Milwaukee has won all three games of the Fall Classic, eight straight dating to the NL Division Series and 10 of 11 postseason games overall. The Brewers put themselves in position to bring out the brooms after eking out a pair of one-run victories before erupting for eight runs with two outs in the fifth inning of a 10-1 rout Monday. While Milwaukee is looking to end the series, Tampa Bay is simply trying to extend it. The Rays are attempting to overcome a 0-3 deficit in a best-of-seven series for only the second time in MLB history. The 2004 Boston Red Sox accomplished the feat after rebounding from a 19-8 loss to the rival New York Yankees in Game 3 to win the final four games of the American League Championship Series. "We've got nothing to lose, so we might as well play like it," said Tampa Bay's Cam Booser, who allowed four runs on four hits without recording an out in relief of starter Freddy Peralta in Game 3. Right-hander Griffin Jax (0-1, 6.00 ERA) will try to help the Rays stave off elimination as the Game 4 starter. Jax has not pitched since taking the loss in Game 3 of the ALCS against the Cleveland Guardians, allowing three runs on five hits over four innings in Tampa Bay's 3-2 road loss Oct. 15. He did not allow a hit over one scoreless inning in a no-decision against Milwaukee on March 30, but struggled two days later. He surrendered five runs, three earned, on three hits without recording an out in an 8-2 loss to the Brewers. Jax, 31, is 0-3 with a 6.75 ERA in 12 career appearances, including one start, against Milwaukee. He will need to be careful against Jackson Chourio, who capped an eight-run fifth inning Monday with an RBI double as part of a four-hit performance. Chourio is 8-for-14 with four runs in the first three games of the World Series. "He's a special player, not just a special hitter. He's just so talented. I think people forget how young he is," Brewers hitting coach Daniel Vogelbach said. "He's just a kid. He could be playing college baseball right now." William Contreras collected three hits Monday to improve to 7-for-13 with three RBIs in the World Series. He is 18-for-43 with three home runs, eight RBIs and six runs in the postseason overall. The Brewers had not announced their Game 4 starter. Brandon Woodruff said he was scheduled to open Tuesday's game before pitching the ninth inning in Game 3. --Field Level Media

item.title: Beiersdorf CEO says company is 'there to stay' in Russia
item.description: German skincare company Beiersdorf has no plans to leave Russia, its chief executive said on Tuesday, arguing the company needed to remain in the country to protect the Nivea brand after a dispute with a local business partner hurt third-quarter sales.
item.dc:creator: Cian Muenster, Paolo Laudani
item.content:encoded: German skincare company Beiersdorf (BEIG.DE) has no plans to leave Russia, its chief executive said on Tuesday, arguing the company needed to remain in the country to protect the Nivea brand after a dispute with a local business partner hurt third-quarter sales. The maker of Nivea said a commercial [USN:S8N44P04I TEXT:"dispute"] involving its Russian subsidiary and a local business partner weighed on third-quarter performance, but that the matter had been resolved and normal operations had resumed. "We are there to stay in Russia with our brand, protecting the brand, paying the salary for people," CEO Vincent Warnery told analysts on a call. Beiersdorf is among a shrinking number of Western consumer goods companies that continue to operate in Russia more than four years after Moscow's invasion of Ukraine, even as many foreign firms have exited the market. Warnery said there was no change to the company's Russia strategy, arguing that remaining in the country helped protect the Nivea brand, which Beiersdorf has sold there since 1906. "We know that if we had left Russia, somebody else could have produced Nivea without us. So we are there to protect the brand and to pay the salaries of our employees. Nothing more, nothing less," he said. Sales in Eastern Europe fell 14.6% in the third quarter, but were down just 1.3% excluding Russia.

item.title: India's Radico Khaitan quarterly profit jumps on premium spirits demand
item.description: Indian liquor maker Radico Khaitan reported a 66% rise in quarterly profit on Tuesday, as robust demand for luxury and premium spirits lifted margins.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian liquor maker Radico Khaitan (RADC.NS) reported a 66% rise in quarterly profit on Tuesday, as robust demand for luxury and premium spirits lifted margins. The maker of Jaisalmer craft gin and Royal Ranthambore whisky has been benefiting from a pivot from its popular portfolio to premium offerings, which carry higher margins and tend to see more resilient, less price-sensitive demand. Here are some details: The liquor maker posted a consolidated net profit of 2.32 billion rupees ($24.39 million) for the quarter ended September 30, up from 1.4 billion rupees a year earlier Overall core profit margin expanded 462 basis points to 20.4% Revenue from operations rose 10.4% year-on-year to 55.8 billion rupees Volume in the company's higher-end "prestige and above" segment grew 36% during the quarter, driven by higher sales for vodka The company said that a rationalised duty framework in Karnataka is showing early signs of a more premium-friendly market, with encouraging signals from Tamil Nadu as well The company separately announced on Tuesday that it would bring finance chief Dilip Banthiya onto the board as an executive director alongside CFO duties effective October 28 It also said that Senior Vice President Saket Somani would serve as deputy chief financial officer from the same date Shares of the company rose about 2% to 4,285 rupees in afternoon trading ($1 = 95.1350 Indian rupees)

item.title: Receita do HSBC no 3º tri fica abaixo das estimativas; ações caem
item.description: O HSBC divulgou nesta terça-feira um salto no lucro trimestral, mas a receita ficou abaixo das estimativas, em parte devido ao crescimento mais lento em seu segmento de gestão de patrimônio, o que levou as ações do banco a uma queda de 6%.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O HSBC (HSBA.L) divulgou nesta terça-feira um salto no lucro trimestral, mas a receita ficou abaixo das estimativas, em parte devido ao crescimento mais lento em seu segmento de gestão de patrimônio, o que levou as ações do banco a uma queda de 6%. O maior banco da Europa divulgou que o lucro antes dos impostos subiu 32%, para US$9,6 bilhões, no trimestre de julho a setembro, em linha com as estimativas, e lançou um programa de recompra de ações de até US$1 bilhão, o mesmo valor do trimestre anterior. No entanto, a receita ficou abaixo das previsões dos analistas, que apontavam para US$19 bilhões, registrando um crescimento de 5%, para US$18,6 bilhões. A queda nas ações do banco listadas em Hong Kong ( ) ressalta como os recentes resultados sólidos dos bancos europeus aumentaram as expectativas dos investidores em relação ao desempenho, mesmo com o impacto da guerra no Irã sobre a inflação e as taxas de juros tornando o ambiente mais difícil para os bancos. As ações continuam com alta de 9% no acumulado do ano. “Às vezes, há uma expectativa do mercado de que revisemos para cima nossas orientações ou metas”, disse a diretora financeira Pam Kaur a repórteres em uma teleconferência, quando questionada sobre a queda das ações. A receita da divisão de gestão de patrimônio do HSBC ficou estável em US$2,7 bilhões. Isso se compara a um crescimento de receita de 15% e 23% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior nos dois primeiros trimestres. BANCOS BRITÂNICOS SE PREPARAM PARA AUMENTOS DE IMPOSTOS O HSBC se beneficiou da ausência de provisões legais contabilizadas no mesmo trimestre do ano anterior. O banco também informou que as perdas de crédito esperadas caíram 17%, para US$800 milhões, graças a uma redução nas despesas relacionadas ao setor imobiliário de Hong Kong, bem como aos seus negócios de gestão de patrimônio no Reino Unido e no México. O HSBC afirmou que está no caminho para atingir suas metas de lucratividade principal até 2028, mais um sinal de como as instituições financeiras da região têm mantido lucros robustos nos últimos anos. O forte desempenho intensificou os apelos de ativistas no mercado doméstico do HSBC, no Reino Unido, por aumentos de impostos sobre os bancos no primeiro orçamento do ministro das Finanças, John Healey, previsto para quarta-feira. Os executivos dos bancos têm feito forte lobby para evitar tal aumento nas tributações do setor, argumentando que isso restringiria os empréstimos e tornaria o Reino Unido menos competitivo. O HSBC anunciou um dividendo intermediário de US$ 0,1 por ação, o mesmo valor do trimestre anterior. (Reportagem de Selena Li, em Hong Kong, e Lawrence White, em Londres)

item.title: Nvidia e Meta estreitam laços na área de IA com acordo de investimento de US$3 bi
item.description: A Nvidia e a Meta anunciaram nesta terça-feira que irão aprofundar sua parceria em torno do assistente de IA Muse e de modelos de IA relacionados, com a Nvidia investindo US$3 bilhões na oferta de ações da controladora do Facebook.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Nvidia (NVDA.O) e a Meta (META.O) anunciaram nesta terça-feira que irão aprofundar sua parceria em torno do assistente de IA Muse e de modelos de IA relacionados, com a Nvidia investindo US$3 bilhões na oferta de ações da controladora do Facebook. Os modelos e agentes Muse da Meta, que rodam na infraestrutura da Nvidia, trabalharão em colaboração mais estreita com a fabricante de chips para melhorar o desempenho e reduzir custos. O Muse, conhecido internamente como Hatch, é fundamental para o plano do presidente-executivo Mark Zuckerberg de oferecer “superinteligência pessoal” aos bilhões de pessoas que utilizam os serviços da Meta diariamente. Inspirado no agente de IA de código aberto OpenClaw, o Muse pode acessar emails, calendário, pagamentos, informações de saúde, compras e aplicativos de casa inteligente do usuário, sendo que os usuários podem revogar o acesso a qualquer momento. A Meta também aumentou sua oferta de ações para US$97,5 bilhões, a maior captação de recursos de sua história, à medida que acelera os investimentos em infraestrutura de IA. As empresas podem explorar uma colaboração mais estreita na estrutura OpenShell da Nvidia, incluindo o uso dessa estrutura para implantar software com segurança e o uso de uma ferramenta chamada Sentry para monitorar o comportamento dos agentes de IA. (Reportagem de Shivani Tanna em Bengaluru)

item.title: OPEC+ oil producers set to keep output targets steady at Sunday meeting, sources say
item.description: OPEC+ oil-producing countries are likely to keep their December oil output targets steady on Sunday, three people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters, in line with expectations that further output policy adjustments are unlikely until next year.
item.dc:creator: Olesya Astakhova, Ahmad Ghaddar
item.content:encoded: OPEC+ oil-producing countries are likely to keep their December oil output targets steady on Sunday, three people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters, in line with expectations that further output policy adjustments are unlikely until next year. The online meeting of seven core OPEC+ members — Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman — comes as Gulf members have been boosting exports that have been disrupted for months by the Iran war . Most, however, are still pumping well below their output targets. All three people declined to be named and said no final decision had been made. OPEC+ comprises the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and allies including Russia. OPEC and authorities in Russia did not immediately respond to requests for comment. In September, OPEC+ completed the phased rollback of a 1.65 million-barrel-per-day supply cut first agreed in 2023. Disruption caused by the Iran war has meant Gulf producers are falling below their quotas. Reuters [USN:L6N43U0TI TEXT:"reported in July"] that OPEC+ was likely to make no changes to its targets during the fourth quarter as it turns its focus to 2027 quota negotiations. The group still has one more layer of production cuts of about 2 million bpd covering most members through the end of 2026. OPEC+ needs to finalise a review of members' production capacity before setting the 2027 baselines that will determine future quotas and shape plans to unwind those cuts, sources have said.

item.title: AFC to refer Jordan FA chief to judicial bodies over Infantino claims
item.description: The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) on Tuesday said it would refer Jordan Football Association President Prince Ali bin Hussein to its judicial bodies, after he accused FIFA President Gianni Infantino of hijacking the AFC Congress for political purposes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) on Tuesday said it would refer Jordan Football Association President Prince Ali bin Hussein to its judicial bodies, after he accused FIFA President Gianni Infantino of hijacking the AFC Congress for political purposes. At the AFC's extraordinary congress in Tokyo on Friday, its president Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al-Khalifa [USN:L1N46902J TEXT:"endorsed Infantino's bid for re-election"] as FIFA president. Only three months after the confederation accused Infantino of a "fundamental breach of trust" over the abandoned FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal to sell a stake in FIFA tournaments, Sheikh Salman told the congress that Asia was now united behind Infantino. Following the congress, [USN:L3N46B01B TEXT:"Prince Ali alleged"] that nobody was allowed to speak, question, debate or talk with the media and that the last day of the event was "pure politics". In response, the AFC said neither Prince Ali nor any other member association's representatives had requested to speak and that it rejected any suggestion that proceedings were conducted improperly. "The AFC takes seriously the unsupported and entirely unsubstantiated allegations of coercion, threats or bribery. Such serious accusations must be supported by credible evidence and should not be made without a proper factual basis," it added. "Accordingly, the AFC will refer the statements made by the President of the Jordan Football Association, including the allegations raised, to the relevant AFC judicial bodies for their consideration and any further action deemed appropriate in accordance with the AFC Statutes and applicable regulations." In August, Prince Ali [USN:L4N4411O7 TEXT:"launched a public attack"] on Infantino, accusing him of "blackmail" and saying FIFA had offered to help solve the kingdom's problems in exchange for his endorsement.

item.title: Citi e BCA rebaixam recomendação de ativos brasileiros após reeleição de Lula
item.description: O Citigroup e a BCA Research rebaixaram a recomendação dos ativos brasileiros após a vitória eleitoral do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, argumentando que o perfil de risco-retorno para ações, títulos e moeda se deteriorou, à medida que os investidores reavaliam as perspectivas de disciplina fiscal e reformas estruturais sob o novo governo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Citigroup e a BCA Research rebaixaram a recomendação dos ativos brasileiros após a vitória eleitoral do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, argumentando que o perfil de risco-retorno para ações, títulos e moeda se deteriorou, à medida que os investidores reavaliam as perspectivas de disciplina fiscal e reformas estruturais sob o novo governo. Essas avaliações refletem uma mudança mais ampla no posicionamento dos investidores, com estrategistas alertando que uma política fiscal mais flexível, uma dinâmica mais fraca da dívida pública e um avanço mais lento nas reformas voltadas para o crescimento podem pesar sobre os mercados brasileiros, apesar das restrições impostas por um Congresso mais conservador. O Citi encerrou na segunda-feira suas posições bullish no Brasil após a vitória eleitoral de Lula, retirando sua recomendação de "overweight" em ações e encerrando sua posição comprada no real . "Embora os preços possam muito bem cair além dos níveis justos, o mercado já estava otimista antes disso, o que torna plausível uma queda excessiva. Dado o resultado da eleição, encerramos nossa exposição ao risco no Brasil", afirmou o Citi. Os ativos brasileiros despencaram na segunda-feira, com o real caindo mais de 11% em relação ao dólar e o índice de ações Bovespa (.BVSP) registrando uma queda de 13,9% — sua maior queda em um único dia desde março de 2020. Os investidores esperam que as recentes apostas em uma mudança de governo sejam revertidas. A BCA Research rebaixou, nesta segunda-feira, a recomendação do Brasil em relação aos mercados emergentes, afirmando que a vitória de Lula "acaba com a perspectiva de um governo ortodoxo que promova melhorias estruturais nas contas fiscais e no crescimento potencial do Brasil". A BCA rebaixou as ações brasileiras de "neutro" para "underweight", citando riscos crescentes de inadimplência, perspectivas de crescimento mais fracas e pressões inflacionárias decorrentes de uma moeda mais fraca. A empresa também rebaixou os títulos em moeda local e o crédito soberano do Brasil de "overweight" para "underweight", alertando para a deterioração da dinâmica da dívida. (Reportagem de Rashika Singh em Bengaluru)

item.title: Zone euro-La croissance des prêts aux entreprises se maintient en septembre-BCE
item.description: La croissance des prêts aux entreprises dans la zone euro est restée stable en septembre, montrent les données publiées mardi par la Banque centrale européenne (BCE).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La croissance des prêts aux entreprises dans la zone euro est restée stable en septembre, montrent les données publiées mardi par la Banque centrale européenne (BCE). Le crédit aux entreprises non-financières a progressé de 4,2% sur un an en septembre, après le même chiffre en août. Les prêts aux ménages ont quant à eux augmenté de 3,1% en septembre, après le même chiffre le mois précédent. La croissance de la masse monétaire en zone euro, qui peut influer sur la croissance économique, a augmenté de 3,5% en septembre, plus qu'anticipé dans le consensus Reuters (3,4%) et après +3,5% en août.

item.title: Meghan Markle participará en la edición australiana de MasterChef Junior el próximo año
item.description: Meghan, esposa del príncipe Enrique de Reino Unido, protagonizará en 2027 la próxima temporada de MasterChef Junior Australia, con lo que regresará a una franquicia en cuya versión para adultos participó como jurado invitada este año.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Meghan, esposa del príncipe Enrique de Reino Unido, protagonizará en 2027 la próxima temporada de MasterChef Junior Australia, con lo que regresará a una franquicia en cuya versión para adultos participó como jurado invitada este año. Meghan, que era actriz en Estados Unidos antes de casarse con Enrique en 2018, se ha mudado recientemente de Estados Unidos a Reino Unido con su familia. Según informaciones de prensa, estaba interesada en encontrar un nuevo papel como actriz. Channel 10 anunció en Instagram que MasterChef Junior Australia regresaría en 2027, con Poh Ling Yeow y Meghan, duquesa de Sussex, como presentadoras. El sitio web australiano News.com.au informó de que estaba previsto que la grabación se realizara en Melbourne entre principios y mediados del próximo año. Enrique y Meghan han atraído la atención de los medios de todo el mundo desde que en 2020 dejaron de ejercer como miembros de primera línea de la familia real, antes de trasladarse a Estados Unidos, donde concedieron varias entrevistas en las que criticaron a la institución. La pareja volvió a acaparar titulares la semana pasada, después de que las autoridades de Filipinas anunciaran que investigaban si Thomas Markle, padre de Meghan, había poseído imágenes de abuso sexual infantil. Ella afirmó estar "profundamente consternada" por las acusaciones.

item.title: Euro zone lending holds up even as banks tighten access
item.description: Lending in the euro zone continued to grow at a healthy pace in September even as banks tightened access to credit on the back of higher interest rates and geopolitical turmoil, European Central Bank data showed on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lending in the euro zone continued to grow at a healthy pace in September even as banks tightened access to credit on the back of higher interest rates and geopolitical turmoil, European Central Bank data showed on Tuesday. The ECB has been gradually raising rates to stem an energy-driven rise in inflation, although it [USN:L6N45U0QU TEXT:"is expected"] to stay put at this week's meeting to garner more evidence on how higher borrowing costs, [USN:L2N46C07E TEXT:"including on the bond market"], are [USN:L6N4690J4 TEXT:"affecting the economy"]. The central bank's own data painted a picture of relative resilience: lending to firms and households grew by 4.2% and 3.1% respectively last month, a stable pace when compared to August. However, the ECB's quarterly Bank Lending Survey showed the impact of its rate hikes, which started in June and [USN:L6N45U0QU TEXT:"are expected"] to continue for months, was becoming visible, with demand for mortgages falling and credit becoming harder to get. A net 27% of banks reported a decrease in demand for housing loans in the third quarter of the year, a more pronounced decline than lenders had expected (-12%) and than they had reported in the previous three months (-15%). "Increases in interest rates were the main driver of the decline, followed by falling consumer confidence and worsening housing market prospects," the ECB said in a press release. Banks did not raise the bar for granting mortgages during the quarter although they did so for corporate loans and consumer credit. They expect to tighten standards for all types of lending in the last three months of the year. France, which is at the centre of [USN:L2N46C07E TEXT:"bond market"] turmoil over its public finances, was the large European country where such tightening was most pronounced. "Heightened risk perceptions and banks’ reduced risk tolerance remained the main drivers of tighter credit standards, with some banks reporting increasing pressure as a result of geopolitical uncertainty and energy developments," the ECB said.

item.title: La UE se prepara para una importante inversión en recursos australianos, según el embajador
item.description: La Unión Europea prevé una oleada de inversiones en el sector australiano de los minerales críticos, en su esfuerzo por diversificar su cadena de suministro y reducir su dependencia de China, declaró el martes el embajador de la UE en Australia, Lawrence Meredith.
item.dc:creator: Melanie Burton
item.content:encoded: La Unión Europea prevé una oleada de inversiones en el sector australiano de los minerales críticos, en su esfuerzo por diversificar su cadena de suministro y reducir su dependencia de China, declaró el martes el embajador de la UE en Australia, Lawrence Meredith. Australia y la Unión Europea firmaron un acuerdo de libre comercio en marzo, tras ocho años de negociaciones, con el que se eliminan los aranceles sobre casi todos los productos y se facilita el acceso de la UE a los minerales críticos australianos. Una vez que ambas partes firmen y ratifiquen dicho acuerdo, lo que se espera que ocurra a principios del próximo año, se eliminará el arancel del 5,5% que la UE aplica a los minerales críticos. "Va a suponer un punto de inflexión", dijo Meredith. Paralelamente, las conversaciones están "muy avanzadas" para que Australia firme un memorando de entendimiento con el Banco Europeo de Inversiones, que actuaría como vehículo de financiación del bloque, añadió Meredith. "La Unión Europea hará inversiones masivas en minerales críticos. Dado que queremos diversificar nuestras fuentes de suministro más allá de China, uno de los socios más probables tiene que ser Australia", señaló. Las propuestas políticas de la UE han destinado hasta 10.000 millones de euros (11.200 millones de dólares) a las materias primas críticas dentro del fondo de competitividad más amplio, de 409.000 millones de euros, mientras la UE debate su presupuesto para el periodo 2028-2034. Australia es una de las varias "superpotencias" en materia de minerales críticos en las que la UE pretende invertir, junto con Brasil, Sudáfrica y Canadá. La UE también prevé invertir a lo largo de la cadena de suministro, incluido el sector del procesamiento, señaló Meredith. Australia anunció el martes que actualizaría su estrategia sobre minerales críticos para hacer mayor hincapié en el refinado y el procesamiento, a medida que se intensifica la competencia por la inversión y persisten las preocupaciones sobre la cadena de suministro. El bloque está analizando inicialmente los minerales a los que Australia dará prioridad para su reserva estratégica: galio, antimonio y tierras raras. Las empresas australianas que avancen más rápidamente en las primeras fases de desarrollo de los proyectos acelerarían el proceso de inversión, señaló. "(El acuerdo de libre comercio) es una señal de que Europa quiere hacer mucho más con Australia. También contamos con una asociación en materia de seguridad y defensa. Gran parte de ella se basa en tecnología de doble uso, y requiere precisamente estos minerales críticos", dijo. La Unión Europea tiene previsto destinar 800.000 millones de euros a defensa en el marco de la iniciativa "ReArm Europe" de aquí a 2030. Australia también va por buen camino para incorporarse el año que viene a "Horizonte Europa", el programa insignia de financiación de la UE para la investigación y la innovación. Meredith afirmó que 2026 había sido un año "transformador" para las relaciones entre Australia y la UE. "Se ha producido un gran impulso en las relaciones entre la UE y Australia en 2026, y estoy muy seguro de que daremos un paso más allá en 2027". (1 dólar = 0,8961 euros)

item.title: Chinese brands show Mbappe red card over alleged Mao meme comments
item.description: A number of Chinese brands have cut ties with French soccer captain Kylian Mbappe over comments he reportedly made referring to the late Chinese leader Mao Zedong.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A number of Chinese brands have cut ties with French soccer captain Kylian Mbappe over comments he reportedly made referring to the late Chinese leader Mao Zedong. In a video that emerged online on Monday, Mbappe is heard saying that the funniest meme he had seen of himself was one where his face had been photoshopped on to that of "some guy — I think he’s a Chinese dictator". Reuters has not been able to authenticate the video. His comments were believed to be an apparent reference to a meme of Mbappe superimposed on an image of Mao, one of several using the soccer player’s face and other historical figures. In China, satire or jokes about Mao, the country’s founding leader who died in 1976, are considered disrespectful and remain a social taboo. Many Chinese media outlets on Tuesday condemned Mbappe's apparent remarks, but did not repeat them. "What did he say? Many Chinese would rather not repeat it," the state-backed Global Times said. "The message from Chinese consumers is clear: Respect is not optional; one doesn't get to profit from China while disrespecting it. Not a chance." Brands including dairy companies Mengniu (2319.HK) and Shanghai Milkground Food Tech (600882.SS) as well as Eastroc Beverage (605499.SS) said they were ceasing all co-operation with Mbappe, who plays his club soccer for Real Madrid, effective immediately. The companies said they "firmly oppose and have zero tolerance for any words or actions that hurt the feelings of the Chinese people." China's state television has halted broadcasts of all matches and events involving LaLiga and Mbappe, and all advertisements involving Mbappe have been removed, state-backed media outlet the Paper reported on Tuesday. Mbappe's representatives, LaLiga and Real Madrid did not immediately respond to a request for comment. TRENDING ON WEIBO As of 0700 GMT, four topics related to Mbappé were still among the top 10 trending searches on China's social media platform Weibo. Some netizens called for China to "blacklist" Mbappé and reduce his commercial value to zero. These comments received hundreds of likes. Fans have been creating memes superimposing Mbappe's face on images of military and political leaders to suggest that he has the power to call the shots at the teams he plays for. In an interview with L'Equipe last month, Mbappe said that while some aspects of the meme trend were harmless fun, the viral ones depicting him as a dictator showed "a lack of political and human awareness." When asked about the incident, a spokesperson for China's Foreign Ministry said that words and actions that hurt the feelings of the Chinese people "will naturally be met with joint opposition from all sectors of the Chinese society."

item.title: Mercedes-Benz cuts 2026 car margin outlook on China weakness, higher costs
item.description: Mercedes-Benz on Tuesday cut its profit margin outlook for 2026 for its core cars division, citing increasingly challenging market environment in China and higher costs in the fourth quarter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mercedes-Benz (MBGn.DE) on Tuesday cut its profit margin outlook for 2026 for its core cars division, citing increasingly challenging market environment in China and higher costs in the fourth quarter. Its shares were down 5.3% as of 0911 GMT, on track for their biggest intra-day drop since May 2025. The German premium automaker now expects an adjusted return on sales of 2%-3% in 2026, down from its previous guidance of 3% to 5%. The company also cut its 2026 group operating profit guidance, now expecting earnings to be broadly flat year-on-year rather than significantly higher. Mercedes' core car sales [USN:S8N44400M TEXT:"fell"] 8% year-on-year in the third quarter, weighed down by weak demand in China. German carmakers have continued to report declining sales in China, while Chinese rivals are [USN:L6N45Y0PI TEXT:"gaining ground"] in Europe, using competitive pricing and advanced EV technology to expand in a market long dominated by Western brands.

item.title: Two men charged in UK with helping Iran over RAF Fairford incident
item.description: British prosecutors said on Tuesday they had charged two men under the National Security Act over an incident last month at the RAF Fairford airbase, with police saying the two were suspected of assisting Iran.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British prosecutors said on Tuesday they had charged two men under the National Security Act over an incident last month at the RAF Fairford airbase, with police saying the two were suspected of assisting Iran. [USN:L1N45R08W TEXT:"RAF Fairford"] had been used by US bombers to carry out strikes on Iran, but they [USN:L1N45R04X TEXT:"were withdrawn"] on security grounds shortly after five British men were arrested outside the military base in southwest England in the early hours of September 27. The Crown Prosecution Service said it had charged Mohmed Abdulkarim, 24, with engaging in conduct that was likely to materially assist a foreign intelligence service. Nouman Essghir, 24, was charged with one offence of entering a prohibited place for a purpose prejudicial to the UK on August 22. The pair will appear in court later on Tuesday. Assistant Commissioner Laurence Taylor, Head of National Counter Terrorism Policing in the UK, said police believed the country Abdulkarim was assisting was Iran.

item.title: Initial global sales of Apple iPhone 18 Pro higher than 17 series - Counterpoint Research
item.description: Global sales of Apple's iPhone 18 Pro series in the first three weeks after launch were 3.1% higher than for the iPhone 17 Pro series over the same period a year ago, according to Counterpoint Research.
item.dc:creator: Che Pan, Eduardo Baptista
item.content:encoded: Global sales of Apple's iPhone 18 Pro series in the first three weeks after launch were 3.1% higher than for the iPhone 17 Pro series over the same period a year ago, according to Counterpoint Research. The smartphones performed well in markets such as China and India but more modestly elsewhere, Counterpoint said, pointing to a mixed start. Sales in China rose 29% from a year earlier, the strongest growth of any market, as early stock of the iPhone 18 Pro series was higher than for last year's 17 Pro phones and price increases on rival flagship Android models from Chinese Android makers boosted demand. Excluding China, global sales growth would have been far weaker, according to the research firm. Sales in the United States and Japan fell 4% and 27% respectively from a year earlier with the new models more expensive than their predecessors. Counterpoint said US consumers saw few meaningful improvements in features or design over previous models to justify the price. In Japan, demand shrank as exchange rates amplified the price increases. The iPhone 18 Pro Max accounted for 56% of sales within the iPhone 18 Pro series, a slight decrease from 57% last year.

item.title: China enviará un emisario especial a Oriente Medio en un futuro próximo
item.description: China está muy preocupada por los conflictos en Oriente Medio y las regiones circundantes, y Pekín enviará un emisario a los países pertinentes en un futuro próximo, según declaró el martes el portavoz del Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores Guo Jiakun en una rueda de prensa diaria.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China está muy preocupada por los conflictos en Oriente Medio y las regiones circundantes, y Pekín enviará un emisario a los países pertinentes en un futuro próximo, según declaró el martes el portavoz del Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores Guo Jiakun en una rueda de prensa diaria. Guo instó a las partes implicadas a resolver sus diferencias mediante el diálogo y la negociación, y también expresó su preocupación por el contagio y la propagación del conflicto de Oriente Medio al Cuerno de África y a la región del mar Rojo. "China enviará en breve a un enviado especial para visitar países de las regiones con el fin de reforzar la comunicación con las partes implicadas, fomentar el contacto y el diálogo, ayudar a aliviar las tensiones y evitar que la situación se deteriore aún más", afirmó Guo. Altos cargos de Arabia Saudita, Turquía y Pakistán se reunieron el lunes en Teherán con autoridades iraníes para rebajar la tensión del conflicto de Oriente Medio, mientras los hutíes de Yemen lanzaban nuevos ataques contra Arabia Saudita y Egipto aprobaba un apoyo en materia de defensa para el reino del golfo Pérsico. Mientras tanto, las tensiones entre Estados Unidos e Irán se han agudizado recientemente, tras las declaraciones del presidente Donald Trump la semana pasada en las que afirmaba que su país podría volver a atacar a Irán. La semana pasada, los ministros de Asuntos Exteriores de China y Yibuti se reunieron en Pekín, donde coincidieron en que aliviar las tensiones en Oriente Medio es clave para abordar los retos de seguridad en el Cuerno de África y el mar Rojo.

item.title: Atacantes matan a 60 personas en la región etíope de Oromiya, según la Iglesia ortodoxa
item.description: Al menos 60 personas perdieron la vida en dos ataques distintos ocurridos la semana pasada en Oromiya, una región etíope castigada por el conflicto armado, según informó la Iglesia ortodoxa etíope.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Al menos 60 personas perdieron la vida en dos ataques distintos ocurridos la semana pasada en Oromiya, una región etíope castigada por el conflicto armado, según informó la Iglesia ortodoxa etíope. Las autoridades eclesiásticas afirmaron que todos los fallecidos eran cristianos, pero no dieron más detalles sobre cómo murieron ni quién estaba detrás de los ataques. El Gobierno regional de Oromiya y una fuente vinculada a una alianza rebelde que lucha contra las fuerzas gubernamentales en la región septentrional de Tigray se culparon mutuamente de los ataques. El Santo Sínodo de la Iglesia tewahedo ortodoxa etíope dijo que 14 fieles fueron asesinados en Merti Woreda el 20 de octubre y 46 en Sherka Woreda el 24 de octubre. Además, se incendiaron más de 20 viviendas y más de 20 personas fueron hospitalizadas con heridas graves, añadió el comunicado de la Iglesia, publicado el lunes. El gobierno regional afirmó que la alianza rebelde lanzó los ataques para intentar provocar un conflicto religioso, sin aportar pruebas. La fuente vinculada a la alianza rebelde dijo que el gobierno regional de Oromiya había llevado a cabo los asesinatos, citando conversaciones con dos residentes locales. El grupo rebelde Ejército de Liberación de Oromo (OLA, por sus siglas en inglés), al que el gobierno regional ha culpado de anteriores ataques contra cristianos ortodoxos, no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. El OLA es uno de los siete grupos armados que anunciaron el mes pasado que habían formado una alianza con el objetivo de derrocar al Gobierno del primer ministro Abiy Ahmed.
